description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates animated drawables. It includes a custom View class that animates a drawable by translating it across the screen using an animation object.

classes.name: AnimateDrawables
classes.description: An Android activity that sets up a custom view to display animated drawables.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View that displays and animates a drawable using a TranslateAnimation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Activity lifecycle method that initializes the view with a new SampleView instance.

methods.name: SampleView.<init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the drawable, creates a translation animation, applies it to the drawable, and starts the animation.

methods.name: SampleView.onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the draw method to clear the canvas and then draw the animated drawable.
